full_page.content:
1946, November 20th
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.P.M. Cap.
Nov. 20th 1946
Mr. and Mrs. Joseph O'Donnell 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Illinois.
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Thanks and praise be to the Lord for all His designs.
God bless you Joseph and Winifred O'Donnell - you and yours.
Many thanks for your generous favors - fruits excellent - and checks, prayers, etc. I have been with this on my mind for weeks
21st Only late last nigh did I get to read your very interesting letter of the 16th. Thanks be to God! How wonderful was His delicate "hold- up" of that letter I had marked "Copy." ....! I sure congratulate you on seemingly providential guidance on your late trip But after all, what might we not expect if we would trust in God and leave things more and more in His divine hands. Simplicity and confidence in God was the real secret of Young Tobias' success in the Old Testiment - and Jacob's too. .... I will try and send the certificates - and write to Mrs. Goodwillie soon .. . Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. Sinner.
